title: DOOM (Shareware)
note: DOOM shareware v1.9, episode 1 'Knee-Deep in the Dead'. Shipped byte-for-byte as published by the js-dos project (cdn.dos.zone/custom/dos/doom.jsdos), including its DOSBox config - no runtime download.
controls: Arrows move/turn, Ctrl fire, Space open/use, Shift run, 1-7 weapons, Esc menu, Enter select. Press a key at the title screen.

title: Wolfenstein 3D (Shareware)
note: Wolfenstein 3D shareware v1.4, episode 1 'Escape from Wolfenstein'. Original WOLF3D.EXE + .WL1 data packed unchanged (source archive: archive.org item wolf3dsw) with an added .jsdos/dosbox.conf.
controls: Arrows move/turn, Ctrl fire, Space open/use, Shift run, 1-4 weapons. The v1.4 memory/sound screen appears first: pick a sound device and press a key.

title: Duke Nukem 3D (Shareware)
note: Duke Nukem 3D shareware v1.3d, episode 1 'L.A. Meltdown'. DN3DSW13.SHR self-extractor from archive.org item 3dduke13SW unpacked unchanged (DUKE3D.EXE, DUKE3D.GRP, LICENSE.TXT, ...), plus .jsdos/dosbox.conf and a DUKE3D.CFG for the emulated Sound Blaster 16 (without it the engine quits with 'Please run SETUP.EXE').
controls: Arrows move/turn, Ctrl fire, Space open/use, A jump, Shift run, 1-9 weapons, Tab map, Esc menu.

title: Commander Keen 4: Secret of the Oracle (Shareware)
note: Commander Keen 4 shareware episode (Goodbye Galaxy, episode 1, v1.0). KEEN4E.EXE and .CK4 data from archive.org Software Library item msdos_Commander_Keen_4_-_Secret_of_the_Oracle_1991, with an added .jsdos/dosbox.conf.
controls: Press any key at the hardware-detection screen, then: arrows move, Ctrl jump, Alt pogo stick, Space/Enter status, F1 help.

title: Bio Menace (Shareware)
note: Bio Menace shareware v1.1, episode 1 'Dr. Mangle's Lab'. Original BMENACE1.EXE + .BM1 data and LICENSE.DOC from archive.org item biomenace1-sw, with an added .jsdos/dosbox.conf.
controls: Press any key at the hardware-detection screen, then: arrows move, Ctrl jump, Alt fire weapon, Space/Enter status, F1 help.

title: Prince of Persia (1990)
license: Freeware release, as distributed by the js-dos project
note: Prince of Persia DOS release shipped byte-for-byte as the js-dos project publishes it (cdn.dos.zone/custom/dos/prince.jsdos); included because the js-dos project distributes this bundle as freely redistributable.
controls: Left/Right walk (hold to run), Up jump, Up+Left/Right careful step, Down crouch/pick up, Shift action (drink, open, fight), Esc menu.
